name: Text animation showcase — kinetic-top-build
description: Showcases the kinetic-top-build renderer family (ADR-0011, short-slide-down catalog effect). The title stacks vertically; each new line drops from above and pushes prior lines to their new centered y positions. Title-only — layout-aware renderer assumes single short-phrase content. Channel chrome notes: chrome-light verification preset; specific syntax-channel motion would be a follow-up Brief.

content.title: Words drop into rhythm
content.body: Vertical stack build — each line lands at its new center as the next word arrives from above.
